column1: # The field menu's apps from the starter save (launch_party_menus_w2_us.pbwinput): the oracle's labelled screens of
# the route, pbw-oracle's hashes of the pinned melonDS's output on the player's dump (SHA-1 of each screen's RGB bytes,
# frames.tsv's top and bottom; hashes only). where: app, a screen of an app the port must show at the row's count
# through Frigate's test launcher (oracle.py launch party_menus); field, a screen of the field or its menu, which the
# port can't show while overlay 36 has no C, held to the oracle's run only. count is GFL's frame count at oracle_frame,
# the first frame with that count. The check leaves out one app row, a known difference of oracle.py's launch routes
# (README.md, "The launch checks"): the summary, whose background scrolls by VBlanks, which the DS spends loading it
# (SUMMARY_SCROLL; its bottom screen shows 3D, bottom_3d). White 2: Black 2's labels at Black 2's counts, measured on
# White 2's oracle from its own starter save, each the same screen, 64 oracle frames sooner. The field's, the Pokedex's
# and the bag's rows are Black 2's hashes, and so is every top screen but the summary's; the menu's, the party list's,
# the summary's and the card's bottom screens are White 2's own.
